posts.title: Strange Planets I: Hossana IX
posts.description: A few weeks ago, my dear friend Saoirse — creator of Trout — came to me with an idea for a project to get us both practicing our game design and writing more. The idea was to build a zine of alien planets with strange, surrealist twists for mothership. This is the horrors I created for the first one, you can find Saoirses planetary report over here! posts.title: The Bestiary Malitiae: Miasmic Fog
posts.description: Another one for the Bestiary, this one with a Mothership stat block. Thanks to onslaught six for helping me edit this one! Miasmic fog On the coldest autumn nights, a strange fog may roll through the valleys.
